output.headline: Ways to make your home more energy efficient
output.text: As you own your home with an F energy rating, you could potentially improve your efficiency. With your oil heating and £167 monthly gas spend, our estimated impact of such changes is 2,246 kg CO2e and 2,540 kWh of energy saved per year. Given your recent £1,830 spend on home improvements and existing mortgage, you might consider further upgrades.
